description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PimDefinedReport entity within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, persists entities, and verifies properties of reports and report groups related to the PIM module.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing functionalities of the Report entity related to PimDefined reports in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating the Report and ReportGroup tables before each test.

methods.name: testAssignLeave
methods.description: Creates and persists a ReportGroup and a Report, then asserts that their properties are correctly set and retrieved.
